lifePath.title: Life Path
lifePath.description: The most important number in the chart, taken from the full birth date. It describes the central lesson, the road you walk and the natural talents you carry through life.

birthday.title: Birthday
birthday.description: The day of the month you were born, a specific gift or talent that supports the Life Path.

expression.title: Expression (Destiny)
expression.description: The sum of every letter in the full birth name. It shows what you are here to do and the abilities you have to do it with.

soulUrge.title: Soul Urge (Heart's Desire)
soulUrge.description: The vowels of the name. It reveals the inner motivation, what the heart wants beneath the surface.

personality.title: Personality
personality.description: The consonants of the name. The outer self, the first impression, the mask that filters what you let in and out.

maturity.title: Maturity
maturity.description: Life Path plus Expression. A goal that comes into focus in the second half of life, once the earlier lessons have been absorbed.

attitude.title: Attitude (Sun Number)
attitude.description: Month plus day of birth. The immediate, habitual stance you take toward new situations.

personalYear.title: Personal Year
personalYear.description: The theme of the current nine-year cycle position, counted from your birthday. Personal Month narrows it to the month in hand.

pinnacles.title: Pinnacles
pinnacles.description: Four long periods of life, each with a number that describes the opportunities of that era. The first Pinnacle ends at 36 minus the Life Path.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.description: Four numbers derived by subtraction from the birth date. Each describes a weakness or lesson that must be met during the matching Pinnacle period. A zero challenge means all lessons apply at once, or none dominates.

karmicLessons.title: Karmic Lessons
karmicLessons.description: Numbers that appear nowhere in the name. They point to qualities not yet developed, which life keeps presenting until they are learned.

hiddenPassion.title: Hidden Passion
hiddenPassion.description: The number that appears most often among the letters of the name. A talent or drive that wants expression even if it is not visible in the core numbers.

planes.title: Planes of Expression
planes.description: How the letters of the name distribute across the mental, physical, emotional and intuitive planes. The dominant plane shows the channel you naturally process life through.

chaldean.title: Chaldean Name Number
chaldean.description: The older Chaldean system assigns letters by vibration rather than alphabet order and does not use 9. It is read as a second opinion on the Expression number.

gematria.title: Gematria
gematria.description: Each letter is given a value and the name is summed. Simple gematria counts A=1 to Z=26; English gematria multiplies that by six; Hebrew (Jewish) gematria maps the 1-9, 10-90, 100-900 pattern of the Hebrew alphabet onto the Latin letters. Matching totals between words or names are read as a hidden resonance.

significance.title: Significant Values
significance.description: Mathematical and traditional properties of every total in the chart: primes, squares, cubes, triangular and Fibonacci numbers, repeating digits, and multiples of the numbers that recur through sacred geometry and scripture.

1.meaning: The number of beginnings. One carries the drive to originate, to lead and to stand alone. Its gift is courage and self-reliance; its shadow is stubbornness and isolation. Ones do best when they use their will to open a path that others can follow.

2.meaning: The number of partnership. Two is diplomatic, receptive and attuned to others, the peacemaker who works behind the scenes. Its gift is empathy and patience; its shadow is over-sensitivity and dependence. Twos grow by valuing their own needs as much as everyone else's.

3.meaning: The number of self-expression. Three is creative, sociable and optimistic, the communicator and entertainer. Its gift is charm and imagination; its shadow is scattered energy and superficiality. Threes flourish when they give their creativity a discipline.

4.meaning: The number of foundations. Four is practical, loyal and methodical, the builder who turns ideas into form. Its gift is reliability and endurance; its shadow is rigidity and narrowness. Fours grow by remembering that the structure serves the life, not the reverse.

5.meaning: The number of movement. Five is adventurous, versatile and curious, hungry for experience in all its forms. Its gift is adaptability and magnetism; its shadow is restlessness and excess. Fives thrive when freedom is used with purpose.

6.meaning: The number of the home and the heart. Six is nurturing, responsible and idealistic, drawn to service, family and beauty. Its gift is love and healing; its shadow is worry and interference. Sixes learn to care without controlling.

7.meaning: The number of the seeker. Seven is introspective, analytical and spiritual, needing time alone to understand what lies beneath appearances. Its gift is depth and insight; its shadow is aloofness and secrecy. Sevens grow by sharing what they find.

8.meaning: The number of mastery in the material world. Eight is ambitious, organised and capable, the executive who understands power and money. Its gift is achievement and generosity; its shadow is domination and materialism. Eights learn that true authority is stewardship.

9.meaning: The number of endings and the universal. Nine is compassionate, wise and broad-minded, the humanitarian who has seen the whole cycle. Its gift is generosity and forgiveness; its shadow is martyrdom and drifting. Nines grow by letting go gracefully.

11.meaning: The first master number. Eleven carries the sensitivity of the Two amplified into intuition, vision and nervous intensity. It is the inspired messenger and the channel. Its shadow is anxiety and self-doubt. Elevens live best when they trust the light they see and ground it in daily practice.

22.meaning: The master builder. Twenty-two combines the intuition of the Eleven with the practicality of the Four, capable of turning great visions into lasting structures that serve many. Its shadow is overwhelm and pressure. Twenty-twos need to work with patience and delegate.

33.meaning: The master teacher. Thirty-three raises the caring Six to the level of selfless service and healing through love. It is rare as a core number and demands a great deal. Its shadow is self-sacrifice to the point of loss. Thirty-threes must include themselves in the circle of care.
